title: Topic 2.4: Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story

pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 2.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: SHORT STORY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.4: Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Which places in the short stories would you like to visit?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the setting - time and place-of a short story

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the setting - time and place-of a short story
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the setting - time and place-of a short story. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story.
4. Show that you can: identify the setting - time and place-of a short story

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a short story and retell what they have read,
2. Digital literacy: It is enhanced as the learner manipulates digital devices while looking at different places at different times.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which places in the short stories would you like to visit?
2. Which time in history would you desire to live?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the setting - time and place-of a short story

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
